result.summary: The failure is a real double-delete (deleter then workos-sync-handler) that lacked the idempotent 404 handling membership and roles already had. The API mapper plus aggregate success-on-entity_not_found matches existing patterns and fixes event retries, not just logging.

problems.title: Split test coverage
problems.detail: The litest stubs entity_not_found at the client; only deleteOrganization.test.ts covers SDK 404 mapping, so there is no single test for the full stack.

problems.title: Redundant WorkOS deletes
problems.detail: Every non-test workspace deletion still calls WorkOS delete twice; idempotency fixes correctness but not the extra API call.

result.betterFix: Optional follow-up: delete the WorkOS org in only one place (or document why both are required) to avoid duplicate API traffic; keep idempotent delete either way.
